reason: Every boundary bit has its register in RTL: vmr_cmd/su_wq go straight into the request bank region flops, su_rr / ij_* / pg_fault are return-region / inject-region / synchroniser flops, the LG tap registers its local/far/near inputs and outputs, inj_rd/inj_addr are captured per inject region on pg_clk (SAFE2 r5). A wrapper stage would move the fixed 3:4 seam calendar (windows 2q..7q) and the release VM 18/15 calendar.
